frames.title: Chisel ready
frames.description: Front-right, behind a stout low wooden stoneworking bench. Left hand holds chisel on a limestone block and right hand raises a small stone mason hammer, safe controlled ready pose.

frames.title: Chisel contact
frames.description: Same bench front-right, hammer lowered to meet chisel on limestone block, chips scattered on tabletop. No motion blur.

frames.title: Measure stone
frames.description: Left-side, measuring and marking a squared stone block with a wooden square and charcoal on stoneworking bench.

frames.title: Dress stone
frames.description: Front-left, dressing a rough stone block with a toothed stone rasp held in both hands on low bench.

frames.title: Lay masonry
frames.description: Front-right, kneeling to set a dressed stone into a short two-course masonry sample with a small trowel, mortar in a wooden tub nearby.

frames.title: Carry stone
frames.description: Front-left, lifting and carrying a heavy squared stone at waist height with both forearms, knees bent, full body and stone visible.

note: Character and work props are composed together. These six scenes are independent static references, not an animation loop.
